notes: Charts and review. Four tabs: Overview (the account against the S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 and Dow for today, the week, the month or three months; how much is invested; where the money sits by holding and by sector), Holdings (each position's price since it was bought, with its entry, stop and target, and why Claude bought it), Journal (trades, the ideas Claude passed on and how they have moved since, the watchlist), and Claude (every run's notes and what the runs used).
